definitions.explanation: An attack using bombs, typically dropped from aircraft. Used in military and historical contexts to describe aerial bombing campaigns or individual bombing attacks.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}が{爆撃|ばくげき}を{受|う}けた。
{爆撃|ばくげき}により{多|おお}くの{建物|たてもの}が{破壊|はかい}された。
examples.english: Many buildings were destroyed by the bombing.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}、この{地域|ちいき}は{何度|なんど}も{爆撃|ばくげき}を{受|う}け、{町|まち}は{焼|や}け{野原|のはら}になった。
examples.english: During the war, this area was bombed repeatedly and the town was reduced to a burned wasteland.

notes:
FORMATION:
{爆|ばく} (explode) + {撃|げき} (strike, attack). Can also function as a する verb: {爆撃|ばくげき}する (to bomb).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空襲|くうしゅう}: air raid — focuses on the aerial nature of the attack
- {爆撃|ばくげき}: bombing — specifically emphasizes the use of bombs
- {砲撃|ほうげき}: bombardment with artillery, not from aircraft

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆撃|ばくげき}を{受|う}ける: be bombed
- {爆撃|ばくげき}する: to bomb
- {爆撃機|ばくげきき}: bomber (aircraft)
- {無差別|むさべつ}{爆撃|ばくげき}: indiscriminate bombing
